overall: The AG found a violation for notice not conspicuously posted at all hours outside the clerk's office, excused by the Town's later website-posting notice; weather and accessibility claims were rejected. No further relief ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice for the January 21, 2014 meeting was not posted where it was conspicuously visible to the public at all hours in or on the municipal building.
allegations.key_passage: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law because the bulletin board outside the clerk's office was not conspicuously visible to the public at all hours.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that snow/blizzard conditions on January 21, 2014 impeded public attendance, and the Board should have cancelled the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not mandate any action by a public body in the face of inclement weather, leaving the decision about whether to cancel a meeting to the discretion of the public body.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the January 21, 2014 meeting location in Town Hall was not accessible to persons with disabilities.
allegations.key_passage: According to the Civil Rights Division of this Office, because the second floor conference room is accessible by a vertical lift in operable condition and does not also require the assistance of a staff person for use, the second floor conference room meets the minimum requirements of the ADA.
